dct_description_sm: Accompanied by linked documents (Quarterly updates & international boundary news; Q3 2024, July-September; Database model & annexes, June 2018; Land boundary disputes, December 2018; Standards and methodology, March 2024).

Data layers include: archipelagic baselines, disputed contentious sovereignty, disputed Exclusive Economic Zones, disputed sovereignty areas, disputed sovereignty areas with administrative units, EEZ limits, Exclusive Economic Zones, extended continental shelf submissions, implied land limits, implied maritime limits, land boundaries, maritime boundaries, provisional equidistance, shared sovereignty areas, shared sovereignty zones, sovereignty areas, straight baselines, territorial sea limits, undetermined sovereignty areas, and undetermined sovereignty zones.
Publication statement: Ellicott City, MD : International Mapping, October 2024

The GIS files in this package provide detailed coordinate data for international maritime boundaries and any specially designated maritime areas that might be associated with those boundaries. While this information has been compiled from primary sources such as bi-lateral treaties, arbitral awards and court judgments and carefully reproduced and reviewed, it is offered here for informational purposes only. International Mapping makes no representations or warranties as to its accuracy in every instance.
